description: Internal helper functions and debugging utilities for PDFsharp library, including logging, exception handling, and font development helpers.

classes.name: DiagnosticsHelper
classes.description: Contains internal static methods for handling not implemented features and exceptions.

classes.name: DebugBreak
classes.description: Provides a method to trigger a debugger break if attached or always.

classes.name: FontsDevHelper
classes.description: Provides helper methods for font creation, cache state dumping, and font stretch/weight retrieval.

methods.name: HandleNotImplemented
methods.description: Handles not implemented features with different behaviors such as logging or throwing exceptions.

methods.name: ThrowNotImplementedException
methods.description: Throws a NotImplementedException with a given message.

methods.name: ThrowNotSupportedException
methods.description: Throws a NotSupportedException with a given message.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Triggers a debugger break if a debugger is attached or if forced.

methods.name: CreateSpecialFont
methods.description: Creates a font with optional bold/italic simulation.

methods.name: GetFontCachesState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current state of font caches.

methods.name: TryGetStretchAndWeight
methods.description: Retrieves stretch and weight information from a glyph typeface.
